device.basis: JPEG encoder of X-T3 5.11, the X-T20 2.11 encoder's register layout. The driver has one accessor per word: +0x44 size, +0x12c origin, +0x130 pitch, +0x100/+0x10c/+0x110 source, destination and limit, +0x84 table loading and +0x8c table words, +0x28 interrupt mask. The driver's start registers its handler on interrupt line 135 (level) before setting +0x00 bit 0. The handler reads the status +0x24, writes it back and takes bit 4 as a finished run, then reads the stream size +0x94. run_ticks (2 ms at 54 MHz) is not measured.
